title: Understanding VPS Salary 2026: From Hourly Rates to Annual Pay
description: Convert your hourly rate to annual salary for VPS salary 2026. Learn the 38-hour week formula, fortnightly pay, tax, and super. Use our timesheet tool.

faqs.q: How is VPS salary 2026 calculated from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: To estimate your VPS salary 2026 from an hourly rate, multiply the hourly rate by the number of hours worked per week (typically 38 for full-time) and then by 52 weeks. For example, $30 per hour × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $59,280 gross per year. This assumes no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. Your actual VPS salary will be set by your enterprise agreement or award, which may include higher rates and additional payments.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the National Minimum Wage and VPS award rates?
faqs.a: The National Minimum Wage (NMW) from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour or $1004.90 per week for a 38-hour week. This applies to award/agreement-free employees. Most VPS employees are covered by the Victorian Public Service Enterprise Agreement or a modern award, which typically pay above the NMW. For example, the Clerks Private Sector Award or the Victorian Public Service Agreement have higher minimum rates. Always check your specific award or agreement for the correct rate.

faqs.q: Does the VPS salary include superannuation?
faqs.a: No, superannuation is paid on top of your VPS salary. The super guarantee rate from 1 July 2026 is 12% of your ordinary time earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. For a VPS employee earning $80,000 gross per year, super would be an additional $9,600 paid into your super fund. Your salary figure in your contract is usually the base rate before super.

bodyMarkdown:
## How to Convert Your Hourly Rate to a VPS Salary 2026

Whether you are negotiating a new role or checking your current pay, understanding how an hourly rate translates into an annual salary is essential. For Victorian Public Service (VPS) employees, the standard full-time week is 38 hours, and most salaries are quoted as annual figures. This article explains the conversion formula, the role of the fortnight, and how tax and super affect your take-home pay.

### The Basic Formula: Hourly × Hours × 52

The simplest way to estimate your annual gross pay is:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

Assuming a 38-hour week, the calculation becomes:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × 38 × 52**

For example, if your VPS role pays $35 per hour, your annual gross would be $35 × 38 × 52 = $69,160. This is the figure before tax and before super.

### Why 52 Weeks?

A standard year has 52 weeks. While some months are longer, using 52 weeks gives a consistent annual figure. If you are paid fortnightly, your gross fortnight pay would be your weekly pay multiplied by 2. For a $35 per hour rate, weekly pay is $1,330, so fortnightly gross is $2,660.

### National Minimum Wage vs Award vs Agreement Rates

From 1 July 2026, the National Minimum Wage (NMW) is $26.44 per hour or $1004.90 per week for 38 hours, as confirmed by the Fair Work Commission. This is the legal floor for award/agreement-free employees. However, most VPS employees are covered by either a modern award (such as the Clerks Private Sector Award) or the Victorian Public Service Enterprise Agreement. These instruments set higher minimum rates. For example, the Fair Work Commission’s Modern Awards Pay Database contains the calculated minimum rates for each award classification. Always refer to your specific award or agreement for the correct rate.

If you are covered by an award, your minimum wage may be higher than the NMW. Some awards also include introductory rates for new employees, but these are temporary. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides a Pay and Conditions Tool to help you find the right rate.

### Casual Loading and Super

If you work casually, you are entitled to a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate. For the NMW, that means $33.05 per hour. When using our [timesheet](/) tool, you can check a box to add the 25% casual loading. Do not type a rate that already includes the loading.

Superannuation is paid on top of your gross salary. From 1 July 2026, the super guarantee is 12% of your ordinary time earnings, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. For a VPS salary of $80,000, super adds $9,600 per year. This is not deducted from your pay; it is an additional contribution to your super fund.

### Tax and Medicare

Your take-home pay depends on your tax bracket. For the 2026–27 financial year, the resident tax rates are:

- Nil on the first $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

Plus, the Medicare levy of 2% generally applies. For a VPS salary of $69,160, the estimated tax would be approximately $11,667 plus Medicare of $1,383, leaving a take-home of about $56,110. Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page for a more detailed estimate.

### What About VPS Salary 2026 Specifically?

The phrase “VPS salary 2026” often refers to the pay rates under the Victorian Public Service Enterprise Agreement. While we do not have the exact agreement rates here, you can find them on the Victorian Government’s website or through your workplace. The formula above works for any hourly rate. If you know your hourly rate from your agreement, multiply by 38 and 52 to get the annual equivalent. Remember that your agreement may also include allowances, penalty rates, and other payments not captured by this simple conversion.

### Using the Timesheet Tool

Our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) page helps you quickly convert an hourly rate to annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures. Just enter your base hourly rate, select your hours per week (default 38), and the tool does the rest. You can also toggle the casual loading checkbox if applicable.

### A Note on Accuracy

This conversion assumes you work the same hours every week with no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax uses the 2026–26 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

For precise VPS salary 2026 figures, consult your enterprise agreement or the Fair Work Commission’s Modern Awards Pay Database. The Fair Work Ombudsman also offers free advice and tools.

### Summary

- **Annual gross** = hourly rate × 38 × 52
- **Fortnightly gross** = weekly pay × 2
- **National Minimum Wage** (2026): $26.44/hour, $1004.90/week
- **Casual loading**: add 25% on top
- **Super**: 12% paid on top, up to $270,830
- **Tax**: progressive scale plus 2% Medicare

Use our [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) page for more on the NMW and award rates. For a full breakdown of your pay, try the [timesheet](/) tool.
